text:
Maria (AE): Heads-up — Prospect 'Polaris Health' raised identity governance requirements during their legal review. They want SSO (Okta + Azure AD), SCIM provisioning, delegated RBAC, domain proofing, and customer-managed KMS. Asking for a POC in two weeks and security questionnaire answers. Who can lead tech presales and confirm timelines?

Aj Shah: I can pick this up. Need their SAML metadata + a SCIM test tenant with ~100 sample users. Also confirm whether they expect both Okta and Azure AD in the POC.

Samuel I: Quick note on SCIM: they mentioned delta sync every 30s in their RFP — that's aggressive. Our hosted default is ~60s for deltas; Dedicated can be tuned to support higher burst rates but we should confirm exact throughput and churn. Also need to confirm mapping for roles -> groups.

Nisha K: From a security questionnaire POV: they require customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM), audit logs for provisioning events, and MFA for admin accounts. We'll need the questionnaire PDF to prefill and escalate anything that requires legal signoff.

Leo - Eng: For RBAC we support group->role mapping and delegated admin scopes. I can attach a sample mapping config, e.g., how a SCIM group maps to a Redwood role. For SCIM throughput we recommend batching on the IdP side. Example request headers we support for provisioning: 

```\nPOST /scim/v2/Users\nAuthorization: Bearer <token>\nContent-Type: application/json\n```

We can share a tiny script for bulk create/edit during the POC.

SalesOps: Pricing note — for a POC: Hosted API with SCIM (low churn) is cheapest. Dedicated/reserved gives predictable throughput and easier KMS tie-ins but has a monthly base. I'll draft a ballpark estimate once we have expected MAU, provisioning frequency, and retention needs.

Maria (AE): Timeline: POC kickoff target = Monday two weeks from now. They asked for an off-site private deployment option for PHI handling and DNS TXT domain ownership proofing. Also asked whether we can provide SOC2 artifact excerpts for provisioning.

Aj Shah: Can Eng Platform spin up an ephemeral private VPC POC in ~3 business days? Who owns infra ticketing — Eng Platform or Customer Solutions?

Leo - Eng: Eng Platform owns the infra build. I will open an infra request with specs: private control plane, SCIM endpoints, SAML assertion endpoint, and no GPU required. Need VPC peering/IP allowlist and KMS details if they want CMK.

Samuel I: Domain proofing — we support DNS TXT verification or email-based verification for domain ownership. For enterprise PHI customers they usually prefer DNS TXT.

Nisha K: Also confirm if they require SAML assertion encryption in addition to signing. If so, we'll need to confirm compatibility with both Okta and Azure AD configs.

Maria (AE): Action items: Aj — collect SAML metadata, SCIM test tenant, sample users, and security questionnaire PDF by EOD tomorrow. Leo — open infra ticket for private POC. SalesOps — deliver rough POC pricing estimate by EOD Friday. Nisha — review the security questionnaire when attached. I'll loop in Legal after we have the completed questionnaire.

SecurityBot: Reminder — data handling policy is at https://redwood.com/security/data-handling :bookmark:

Aj Shah: Acknowledged. Pinged Polaris for metadata and test tenant info. Will update thread once they reply. :thumbsup:
